items.name: Outlier AI
items.title: AI response evaluation & training
items.excerpt: 15-100+ (avg $25-38, specialists $50-100) per hour. 60+ countries incl. Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, South Africa, US, UK, most of EU. Never asks for payment to join. If an Outlier page asks for a fee or crypto, it is an imper
items.who: 60+ countries incl. Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, South Africa, US, UK, most of EU

items.name: Mindrift
items.title: AI training & expert evaluation
items.excerpt: 15-100+ (realistic general $8-25, specialists $50-100) per hour. Most countries incl. Nigeria and broader Africa (region-tiered pay). Calculate the real hourly rate before accepting a fixed-price task.
items.who: Most countries incl. Nigeria and broader Africa (region-tiered pay)

items.name: DataAnnotation.tech
items.title: AI response evaluation & annotation
items.excerpt: 20-60+ advertised, realistic $15-40 per hour. Primarily US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand; some African access project-by-project. Verify your country at signup before investing assessment time.
items.who: Primarily US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand; some African access project-by-project

items.name: Alignerr
items.title: Expert AI training & alignment
items.excerpt: 8-150 (specialists up to $150, general $8-18) per hour. Global, including Nigeria and Africa; competitive entry. Legitimate. Backed by Labelbox. No upfront fees.
items.who: Global, including Nigeria and Africa; competitive entry

items.name: Toloka
items.title: Microtasks & crowd labeling
items.excerpt: Under $3-20 on the open crowd; invite-only expert track pays more per hour. 100+ countries incl. most of Africa. Beginner-friendly and open-access, with the lowest pay on this list. Prefer Mindrift for new work.
items.pay: Under $3-20 on the open crowd; invite-only expert track pays more
items.who: 100+ countries incl. most of Africa

items.name: Prolific
items.title: Paid research studies
items.excerpt: 8-20 typical per study per hour. Confirmed: US, UK, most of EU, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, Egypt. Reputable in academic research circles.
items.who: Confirmed: US, UK, most of EU, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, Egypt

items.name: Remotasks
items.title: Crowdsourced annotation
items.excerpt: 3-30 (lower for beginners, higher for LiDAR/technical) per hour. Most countries incl. Nigeria, Kenya, Philippines, India. Legitimate but lower-volume than its 2023-2024 peak.
items.who: Most countries incl. Nigeria, Kenya, Philippines, India

items.name: Appen (Appen Connect / CrowdGen)
items.title: AI training, annotation & search evaluation
items.excerpt: 10-20 typical per hour. 170+ countries. Public company. Never pay to join.
items.who: 170+ countries

items.name: Clickworker
items.title: Microtasks incl. UHRS & AI training
items.excerpt: 5-15 typical per hour. 136 countries. Established. Low pay is the tradeoff, not legitimacy.
items.who: 136 countries

items.name: Surge AI
items.title: Premium AI training & RLHF
items.excerpt: 15-90+ for accepted workers per hour. Selective by project; strong presence for Kenyan/African vetted workers. Legitimate and well-funded. Clients include major AI labs.
items.who: Selective by project; strong presence for Kenyan/African vetted workers

items.name: TELUS Digital AI Community
items.title: Search evaluation & multilingual AI training
items.excerpt: 10-20 typical per hour. 100+ countries. Backed by TELUS. Check hours before applying.
items.who: 100+ countries

items.name: OneForma
items.title: Search evaluation & linguistic work
items.excerpt: 14-20 typical, higher for niche language pairs per hour. Global, strongest for bilingual applicants. Legitimate TELUS-family vendor.
items.pay: 14-20 typical, higher for niche language pairs
items.who: Global, strongest for bilingual applicants

items.name: Mercor
items.title: AI-matched talent marketplace
items.excerpt: 16-200+ depending on role per hour. 45+ countries. Legitimate marketplace, not a microtask board.
items.who: 45+ countries

items.name: Micro1
items.title: Expert AI training & vetted technical roles
items.excerpt: Varies by domain — expert tier per hour. Global, selective via AI interviewer Zara. Well-funded and legitimate. Not instant-start.
items.who: Global, selective via AI interviewer Zara

items.name: iMerit
items.title: Data annotation & structured AI training
items.excerpt: Varies by role per hour. Operates in specific regions (India, US, select global). Expect a hiring process, not instant signup.
items.who: Operates in specific regions (India, US, select global)

items.name: Sama
items.title: Data annotation & AI training
items.excerpt: Varies; often local living-wage benchmarked per hour. Primarily East Africa (Kenya, Uganda) and select regions. Legitimate. Not designed for instant flexible signup.
items.who: Primarily East Africa (Kenya, Uganda) and select regions

items.name: Welocalize RaterLabs
items.title: Search quality & AI rating
items.excerpt: Varies (mid-range) per hour. English-fluent countries, including parts of Africa. Long-running search-quality vendor. Legitimate.
items.who: English-fluent countries, including parts of Africa

items.name: CrowdGen
items.title: Beginner microtasks
items.excerpt: Varies by project (entry-level) per hour. 200+ countries. Beginner entry into the Appen ecosystem.
items.who: 200+ countries

items.name: UHRS (Microsoft)
items.title: Search relevance evaluation for Bing
items.excerpt: Varies (low-mid per task) per hour. Wide, but vendor-gated — not a direct signup. Direct-access UHRS offers outside known vendors are a common scam.
items.who: Wide, but vendor-gated — not a direct signup

items.name: Voices.com
items.title: Voice-over & AI/TTS voice licensing
items.excerpt: Project-based; some deals include royalties per hour. Global. Legitimate voice marketplace. Needs more setup than microtask sites.
items.who: Global
